### Hypergeometric test in graph
edge.hypergeometric.test = function(subtype1, subtype2){  
  for (class_1 in 1:n_classifiers){
    for (class_2 in 1:n_classifiers){
      table.hypergeometric = table(output_cbind[,class_1], output_cbind[,class_2])
      row_index = match(subtype1 , rownames(table.hypergeometric))
      col_index = match(subtype2 , colnames(table.hypergeometric))
      if (!is.na(row_index) && !is.na(col_index)) {
        pval = phyper(log.p = F, table.hypergeometric[row_index,col_index]-1,sum(table.hypergeometric[,col_index]), sum(table.hypergeometric)-sum(table.hypergeometric[,col_index]), sum(table.hypergeometric[row_index,]), lower.tail = F)
        return(pval)
      }
    }
  }
}

normalize <- function(x) {
  return ((x - min(x)) / (max(x) - min(x)))
}

plot.consensusgraph = function(g, Simplified = T, pval = 0.05, multiple.correction = F, edge.color.hypergeo.test = T){
  colrs <- wes_palette("Darjeeling1",length(V(g)), type=c("continuous"))
  V(g)$color <- colrs[V(g)]
  
  if (Simplified) {
    g2 = simplify(g)
  }else{g2 = g}
  
  
  c_scale <- colorRamp(c('black', 'light gray'))
  E(g2)$weight = sapply(E(g2), function(e) { 
    pval = edge.hypergeometric.test(subtype1 = ends(g2, e)[1], subtype2 = ends(g2, e)[2])
  })
  
  if (multiple.correction) {
    E(g2)$weight = p.adjust(E(g2)$weight, method = "BH", length(E(g2)$weight))
  }
  
  g2=delete.edges(g2, which(E(g2)$weight > pval))
  
  if (!Simplified) {E(g2)$weight = 0.1}
  if (Simplified) {
    if (edge.color.hypergeo.test) {
      E(g2)$color = apply(c_scale(normalize(log(E(g2)$weight))), 1, function(x){
        #print(x)
        rgb(x[1]/255,x[2]/255,x[3]/255) 
      })
    } else {
      E(g2)$color = apply(c_scale(normalize(log(E(g2)$weight))), 1, function(x){
        #print(x)
        rgb(125/255,125/255,125/255) 
      })
    }
    E(g2)$pval = E(g2)$weight
    
    E(g2)$weight = 
      sapply(E(g2), function(e) { 
        intersect = length(all_shortest_paths(g, from=ends(g2, e)[1], to=ends(g2, e)[2])$res)
        union1 = graph.strength(g)[which(names(graph.strength(g))==ends(g2, e)[1])]
        union1 = union1 / n_classifiers_min_self
        union2 = graph.strength(g)[which(names(graph.strength(g))==ends(g2, e)[2])]
        union2 = union2 / n_classifiers_min_self
        as.double((intersect/(union1+union2-intersect)))
      })
  }
  
  return(g2)
}
run.MCLclustering = function(AdjMat, inflationFactor){
  output_mcl=mcl(x = AdjMat, addLoops=T, ESM = F, allow1 = T, inflation = inflationFactor)
  
  var = data.frame()
  for (i in 1:length(output_mcl$Cluster)) {
    cluster.number = output_mcl$Cluster[i]
    cluster.name = row.names(AdjMat)[i]
    if (i == 1) {
      var = c(cluster.number,cluster.name)
    }
    else{
      temp = c(cluster.number,cluster.name)
      var = rbind(var, temp)
    }
  }
  var=as.data.frame(var)
  names(var) = c("mcl_clusters", "cluster_names")
  return(var)
}
StabilityScore = function(referenceMCL, consensusOutcome,n_iterations){
  result <- vector("list", nrow(referenceMCL))
  for (index in 1:nrow(referenceMCL)){
    
    ss.mcl.cluster = referenceMCL$mcl_clusters[referenceMCL$cluster_names[]==rownames(consensusOutcome[index,])]
    ss.original.cluster = referenceMCL$cluster_names[referenceMCL$cluster_names[]==rownames(consensusOutcome[index,])]
    
    freq = rowSums(consensusOutcome[-1] == as.numeric(as.character(ss.mcl.cluster)))[index]
    Stab.Score = freq/n_iterations
    result[[index]] = Stab.Score
  }
  return(result)
}
MedianStabilityScore = function(NetworkOutput, inflation, sil = T, median = T){
  iterations = 10
  set.seed(233)
  for (i in 1:iterations) {
    random_index <- sample(1:nrow(NetworkOutput), 0.8 * nrow(NetworkOutput))
    random_cohort = NetworkOutput[random_index,]
    
    #Transform the dataframe to two columns
    for (x in 1:n_classifiers) {
      for (y in 1:n_classifiers) {
        if (x<y) {
          if (x==1 && y==2) {
            random_df = random_cohort[c(x,y)]
            names(random_df) = c("subtype1", "subtype2")
          }
          else{
            temp = random_cohort[c(x,y)]
            names(temp) = c("subtype1", "subtype2")
            random_df = rbind(random_df,temp)
          }
        }
      }
    }
    random_g.mcl <- graph_from_data_frame(random_df, directed = F)
    #plot.consensusgraph(random_g.mcl)
    random_gx.mcl = as_adjacency_matrix(plot.consensusgraph(random_g.mcl))
    
    random_var = run.MCLclustering(AdjMat = random_gx.mcl, inflation)
    
    if (i == 1) {
      consensus_outcome = random_var
      row.names(consensus_outcome) = consensus_outcome$cluster_names
      consensus_outcome = subset(consensus_outcome, select = -c(cluster_names))
      names(consensus_outcome) = c(paste0("iter_", i))
    }
    if (i > 1){
      random_temp = random_var
      row.names(random_temp) = random_temp$cluster_names
      random_temp = subset(random_temp, select = -c(cluster_names))
      names(random_temp) = c(paste0("iter_", i))
      consensus_outcome = merge(consensus_outcome, random_temp, by= 0, all=T)
      row.names(consensus_outcome) = consensus_outcome$Row.names
      consensus_outcome = subset(consensus_outcome, select = -c(Row.names))
    }
    
  }
  
  consensus_outcome_matrix = consensus_matrix(consensus_outcome)
  rownames(consensus_outcome_matrix) = rownames(consensus_outcome)
  colnames(consensus_outcome_matrix) = rownames(consensus_outcome)
  
  ## Calculate the mode for each row to determine the higher frequency subtype label
  mat_col <- data.frame(group = apply(consensus_outcome, 1, function(v) {
    uniqv <- unique(v)
    uniqv[which.max(tabulate(match(v, uniqv)))]}))
  rownames(mat_col) = rownames(consensus_outcome)
  
  ## Colors:
  ### Heatmap colors
  heatcol <- colorRampPalette(c("white", "#4DAF4A"))
  ### Mode of GIS subtype annotation colors
  mat_colors <- list(group = inferno(length(levels(unique(mat_col$group)))))
  names(mat_colors$group) <- unique(mat_col$group)
  
  heatmap = pheatmap(
    consensus_outcome_matrix,
    col=heatcol(100),
    treeheight_row = 0,
    border_color = "black",
    annotation_col = mat_col,
    annotation_colors = mat_colors
  )
  
  
  if (sil==T) {
    stab.score = as.numeric(StabilityScore(random_var,consensus_outcome,iterations))
    dist_matrix = dist(consensus_outcome_matrix)
    tryCatch({
      sil.object = wcSilhouetteObs(
        diss = dist_matrix,
        clustering = mat_col$group,
        measure = 'ASWw',
        weights = stab.score)
      if (median) {
        return(median(sil.object))
      } else {
        return(mean(sil.object))}
      #return(weighted.mean(sil.object, w=stab.score))
    }
    ,error=function(e){return(0)}
    ) 
  } else {
    print("stability")
    if (median) {
      return(median(as.numeric(StabilityScore(random_var,consensus_outcome,iterations))))
    } else { return(mean(as.numeric(StabilityScore(random_var,consensus_outcome,iterations))))}
  }
}

compute_boxplot_stats <- function(df_long, group_col = "combo", value_col = "value", facet_col = "feature") {
  df_long %>%
    group_by(.data[[facet_col]], .data[[group_col]]) %>%
    summarise(
      n            = sum(!is.na(.data[[value_col]])),
      min          = min(.data[[value_col]], na.rm = TRUE),
      q25          = quantile(.data[[value_col]], 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
      median       = median(.data[[value_col]], na.rm = TRUE),
      q75          = quantile(.data[[value_col]], 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
      max          = max(.data[[value_col]], na.rm = TRUE),
      whisker_low  = min,    # full range, not Tukey-trimmed
      whisker_high = max,
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    rename(group = all_of(group_col), feature = all_of(facet_col))
}

# Export PDFs for each subtyping system
# Function to create and save plots for a given subtyping system
create_subtype_plots <- function(df, subtype_col, filename) {
  # Create combo variable with proper factor ordering
  df_temp <- df %>%
    mutate(combo = factor(
      paste(mol.subtype.adeno.x, !!sym(subtype_col), sep = ":"),
      levels = paste(
        rep(levels(mol.subtype.adeno.x), each = length(levels(!!sym(subtype_col)))),
        rep(levels(!!sym(subtype_col)), times = length(levels(mol.subtype.adeno.x))),
        sep = ":"
      )
    ))
  
  # Reshape to long format
  df_long_temp <- df_temp %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = c(f01, f02, f03, f04, f05, f06, f07), 
                 names_to = "feature", 
                 values_to = "value")
  
    # Per-boxplot (combo x feature) summary stats, full data range
  stats_temp <- compute_boxplot_stats(df_long_temp, group_col = "combo",
                                       value_col = "value", facet_col = "feature")
  stats_csv_filename <- sub("\\.pdf$", "_boxstats.csv", filename)
  write.csv(stats_temp, file = stats_csv_filename, row.names = FALSE)
  message(paste("Saved box stats:", stats_csv_filename))
  
    # Export raw data used for plotting
  csv_filename <- sub("\\.pdf$", "_data.csv", filename)
  #write.csv(df_long_temp, file = csv_filename, row.names = FALSE)
  message(paste("Saved data:", csv_filename))
  
  # Create plots
  plot_list_temp <- list()
  features <- unique(df_long_temp$feature)
  
  for(i in seq_along(features)) {
    feature_name <- features[i]
    
    p <- df_long_temp %>%
      filter(feature == feature_name) %>%
      ggplot(aes(x = combo, y = value, fill = combo)) +
      geom_boxplot() +
      scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE) +  # Keep factor order
      labs(title = feature_name,
           x = "Combination",
           y = "Value") +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(legend.position = "none",
            plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
            axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
    
    plot_list_temp[[i]] <- p
  }
  
  # Arrange and save
  final_plot_temp <- plot_grid(plotlist = plot_list_temp, 
                               ncol = 2, 
                               labels = "AUTO")
  
  #pdf(filename, width = 7, height = 14)
  #print(final_plot_temp)
  #dev.off()
  message(paste("Saved:", filename))
}

# Create PDFs for each subtyping system
create_subtype_plots(df_adeno, "Tan_subtype", "plots_Tan_subtype.pdf")
create_subtype_plots(df_adeno, "Nearest_Rozen_Subtype", "plots_Nearest_Rozen_Subtype.pdf")
create_subtype_plots(df_adeno, "Nearest_subgroup", "plots_Nearest_subgroup.pdf")
